title: Newspaper/Editorial
content: Apply editorial/newspaper design with classic typography focus. Use serif fonts for headings (Georgia, Playfair Display, Times). Implement multi-column text layouts (columns-2 or columns-3) for articles. Create strong typographic hierarchy: large headlines, subheadings, body text, captions. Add drop caps for article beginnings (first-letter:text-5xl float-left). Use thin dividers and rules between sections. Include pull quotes with larger italic text. Monochrome palette with one accent color. Grid-based layouts mimicking print design.

variants.simple: Create classic newspaper-inspired typography and multi-column layouts.
variants.detailed: Apply editorial/newspaper design with classic typography focus. Use serif fonts for headings (Georgia, Playfair Display, Times). Monochrome palette with one accent color. Grid-based layouts mimicking print design.
variants.advanced: Apply editorial/newspaper design with focus on typography and content hierarchy. Typography: serif fonts for headlines (Playfair Display, Merriweather, Georgia) paired with readable sans-serif for body (Inter, Source Sans). Headline sizing: dramatic scale from text-6xl hero to text-xl section heads. Multi-column layouts: use CSS columns (columns-2 md:columns-3 gap-8) for article text with column-rule for dividers. Drop caps: first-letter pseudo-element with text-6xl font-serif float-left mr-3 mt-1. Pull quotes: extracted quotes in larger text (text-2xl italic) with decorative quotation marks, border-l-4 or centered with rules above/below. Section dividers: thin horizontal rules (h-px bg-gray-300 my-8) or decorative ornaments. Bylines and datelines: text-sm text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide. Image treatment: full-bleed images, captioned images with credit lines (text-xs text-gray-400). Sidebar elements: related articles, key facts boxes with bg-gray-50 p-4. Color: primarily black/white/gray with single accent color for links and highlights. Grid: asymmetric layouts with main content + sidebar pattern. Print consideration: proper typographic conventions - hanging punctuation, proper em dashes, smart quotes. Responsive: single column on mobile, progressive enhancement to multi-column on larger screens.
